The Morning Bull - Canadian Market Morning Update Friday, 20 Nov 2026

Canadian equities are set for a softer open, with sentiment pressured mainly by a hawkish US Federal Reserve backdrop. Fed minutes pointing to further tightening, together with a stronger US dollar, are steering investors toward a more cautious stance.

The dollar is trading near multi month highs as expectations for additional Fed moves hold firm. At the same time, broad commodities futures are in the red, with the Bloomberg Commodity Index future down about 1%. That combination signals tougher financial conditions and weaker global demand appetite.

For Canada, a stronger greenback tends to tighten financial conditions by lifting funding costs and drawing capital toward US assets. Lower commodity prices also trim cash flow expectations for resource heavy businesses, which can weigh on earnings assumptions and investor risk tolerance.

The open now hinges on whether incoming Fed speeches later today reinforce the hawkish tone or hint at flexibility. If the rhetoric softens, the current risk off bias in Canadian markets could be challenged rather quickly.

Stocks to Watch Before the Opening Bell

Seabridge Gold (SEA)

Seabridge Gold dropped 29.3% yesterday as a broad selloff in gold producers weighed on the materials sector, which fell 2.9% alongside US dollar strength and expectations for more Fed tightening. At the same time, the B.C. Supreme Court quashed the KSM Project Substantial Start Determination and ordered further consultation with the Tsetsaut Skii km Lax Ha Nation.

Investors now have to track how revised consultations affect project timing, while keeping an eye on support expressed by the Tahltan and Nisga'a Nations and any follow up from the provincial Environmental Assessment Office.

Endeavour Silver (EDR)

Endeavour Silver published a Feasibility Study for its Pitarrilla Project in Durango, Mexico that outlines an underground operation with an 18 year mine life and an after tax NPV of $736 million. The next key question is how Endeavour Silver plans to fund any build out, along with the timing and conditions attached to remaining permit approvals for the site.

Materials and Metals and Mining: Strong dollar pressure meets project risk

Materials and Metals and Mining have had a rough seven days, with both sectors down well into double digits as the strong US dollar and hawkish Fed tone weigh on metal prices.
